ticket.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
ticket.notes: Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.

decision.decision: Recommend a 15% bulk discount at $49.30 per hoodie for 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M units, subject to human approval, while keeping fulfillment contingent on approving the 12-unit restock PO. Do not promise availability or send the drafted customer message until both decisions are approved.
decision.reasoning: Inventory found 8 units in stock versus 20 requested, leaving 12 short; Bulldog Print Co. (vendor ID 1) has a 5-day lead and a 12-unit PO draft is pending approval. Accounting found $22.00 unit cost and $58.00 list price; at 15% off, profit is $546.00 and margin is 55.38%. The draft customer message is saved but not sent. Inventory also reported projected cash after the PO and open invoices of -$112.00, requiring human escalation before approving the PO.
next_steps: Have a human decide whether to approve the 15% discount ($49.30 per unit; proposed total $986.00).
Have a human review the reported -$112.00 projected cash position and approve or reject the 12-unit Bulldog Print Co. PO.
If approved, send the customer message after human review; otherwise revise it without promising the 12-unit balance or discount.
After vendor confirmation and lead-time review, provide the customer a confirmed fulfillment estimate.

customer_messages.subject: Your Basic Hoodie Big Yale bulk request
customer_messages.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We currently have 8 Basic Hoodie Big Yale hoodies in navy, size M, available for your request of 20. The remaining 12 depend on a vendor restock that is pending human approval and has not been sent. The team is also reviewing a proposed 15% bulk discount of $49.30 per hoodie, for a proposed total of $986.00, subject to human approval; we are not promising the discount or delivery at this time. We’ll follow up once availability and pricing are confirmed.

Campus Customs
